name: AhaKey Bridge
description: Mirrors Orca agent status onto the AhaKey X1 light bar: blue breathing while working, yellow when an agent needs you, green flash when done.

settings.title: Keyboard screen text
settings.description: Text shown on the X1's little screen. Uploads once when changed (takes a few seconds — the device shows 'Uploading pic'). Leave empty to leave the screen alone.

statusBarItems.tooltip: Agent status — click to re-sync. Screen text: Orca Settings → AhaKey Bridge
